searchText: We fixed the problem where it would get stuck below 7 I believe. You are correct it can't cross below 7, but just as a side effect, not as an intended function. I'm a fan of testing behavior below 7, just for thoroughness and ensuring consensus, even though it isn't reachable in production. e.g., set to 0, make sure it walks up from there. We hardcoded the base Fee for state tests, but I think it will be worth reading it from the env section like <@!393119312350543872> wrote. But then I guess you only hardcoded it in one state-test path, not the other? Because when I run them through nethtest, it uses `0`
